title: POPANE-R3 Time-Alignment Signal Control
classification: Exploratory mechanism/benchmark diagnostic after POPANE-R1, frozen before any R3 outcome.
purpose: Test whether the same POPANE peripheral features contain genuine time-aligned information about contemporaneous/recent self-reported valence even though they failed to improve future level forecasts beyond persistence.
reuse_from_r1: Identical file inclusion and technical QC.
Identical common anchors and predeclared physiological feature extraction.
Identical deterministic 10-fold participant assignment and simultaneous held-person × held-segment evaluation.
Identical Ridge and HGB learner specifications.
target: prior_affect = mean continuous valence report in [-5,-1] s relative to anchor.

models.real_physiology: time_norm + all predeclared R1 physiology features from [-10,-1] s
models.shifted_physiology: time_norm + the same physiology feature vector circularly shifted within each subject×segment sequence by max(1, floor(n_rows/2)) anchors, generated without consulting target values

rationale: The shift preserves each participant×segment feature distribution and much of its slow structure while disrupting local temporal alignment. If real physiology predicts recent valence better than shifted physiology under held-person × held-segment testing, physiology contains time-aligned affect information even if it does not add future utility beyond persistence.

endpoints.primary: delta_shift_real = MAE(shifted_physiology)-MAE(real_physiology); positive favors real temporal alignment.
endpoints.secondary: delta_time_real = MAE(time_only)-MAE(real_physiology); positive means physiology adds contemporaneous valence information beyond normalized time.
endpoints.uncertainty: Participant-cluster bootstrap, 5000 replicates, separately for Ridge and HGB.

decisions.ALIGNED_SIGNAL_REPLICATED: Both Ridge and HGB delta_shift_real 95% CIs strictly above zero.
decisions.MODEL_SPECIFIC_ALIGNED_SIGNAL: Exactly one learner has delta_shift_real 95% CI strictly above zero.
decisions.NO_DETECTABLE_ALIGNED_SIGNAL: Neither learner has delta_shift_real 95% CI strictly above zero.

firewalls: This is not a prospective forecasting endpoint.
A positive result establishes predictive time alignment, not causality or bodily necessity.
A null result does not prove physiology lacks emotion information under other representations.
paper_role: Distinguish genuine physiological signal from incremental future forecasting utility in the independent replication dataset.
